title: Rust: Structs and Records
description: Define and use structs with methods in Rust.

steps.title: Define a Struct
steps.description: Define a struct `Book` with fields: `title: String`, `author: String`, `pages: u32`. Create an instance and print its fields.
hints: `struct Book { title: String, author: String, pages: u32 }`

verification.failureMessage: Create and print a Book struct.

steps.title: Struct Methods
steps.description: Add an `impl` block with methods: `summary(&self) -> String` that returns `"title by author"`, and `is_long(&self) -> bool` that returns true if pages > 300.
hints: `impl Book { fn summary(&self) -> String { format!("{} by {}", ...) } }`

verification.failureMessage: Call summary() and is_long() on the book.

steps.title: Associated Functions
steps.description: Add an associated function `new(title: &str, author: &str, pages: u32) -> Book` that creates a new Book instance. Also add a `default()` function.
hints: `default()` can return a hardcoded default book.

verification.failureMessage: Create books using Book::new and Book::default.

steps.title: Tuple Structs
steps.description: Define a tuple struct `RGB(i32, i32, i32)` and a function `mix(a: RGB, b: RGB) -> RGB` that averages each channel. Test with RGB(255, 0, 0) and RGB(0, 0, 255).

verification.failureMessage: Mix red and blue to get purple (127, 0, 127).

steps.title: Struct Update Syntax
steps.description: Create a Book `b1`, then create `b2` using struct update syntax to copy most fields from `b1` but change `pages`. Print both.
hints: The `..b1` copies remaining fields from b1.
Note: this moves String fields from b1 (b1 may no longer be valid).

verification.failureMessage: Create b2 with 500 pages using ..b1 update syntax.
